"""Moderate-size differential test against the naive reference."""
import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/work')
import gen2, ref
from difftest import norm_class, run_main

rnd = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]))
N = int(sys.argv[2])
bad = 0
tot_cls = 0
for it in range(N):
    req = gen2.gen_request(rnd, nf=rnd.randint(1, 4), natoms=rnd.randint(4, 14),
                           k=rnd.randint(1, 4), nrows=rnd.randint(20, 60),
                           ntr=rnd.randint(2, 6), bmax=rnd.randint(1, 3))
    # restrict policy so the naive reference stays feasible
    req['policy']['max_width'] = rnd.randint(1, 3)
    t0 = time.time()
    classes, qout = ref.ref_process(req)
    ref_t = time.time() - t0
    got = run_main(req)
    if isinstance(got, tuple) or 'error' in got:
        print('MAIN FAIL', it, got); bad += 1; continue
    g = sorted(norm_class(c) for c in got['classes'])
    r = sorted(norm_class(c) for c in classes)
    tot_cls += len(r)
    if g != r:
        print('MISMATCH', it); print(json.dumps(req)); print('got', g[:5]); print('ref', r[:5]); bad += 1; continue
    if len(got['queries']) != len(qout):
        print('QLEN', it); bad += 1; continue
    for i, (gg, rr) in enumerate(zip(got['queries'], qout)):
        if (gg['must'], gg['may'], gg['status']) != (rr['must'], rr['may'], rr['status']):
            print('Q MISMATCH', it, i, gg, rr); bad += 1; break
    if ref_t > 20:
        print('slow ref case skipped further', it)
print('difftest4: bad=%d of %d, total classes=%d' % (bad, N, tot_cls))
PYEOF
